links.comparator_used: Standard ChatGPT 4.0 prompting with no reading-level instruction
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of patient education guides
links.effect: Median FKGL 5.8 for simplified ChatGPT responses vs 10.0 for standard ChatGPT responses (and 10.8 for OPEMs); simplified responses significantly easier to read (p < 0.001)
links.quote: Simplified ChatGPT responses aligned with the sixth-grade level and were significantly easier to read than OPEMs and standard ChatGPT responses ( p < 0.001).
